response.justification: Bogdan has extensive software development experience (16+ years) and leadership roles, but lacks direct experience in developer tools, build systems, or testing infrastructure central to the role. His background in AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling is promising, but his mobile-platform and organizational change experience is limited. His people management experience is also not explicitly detailed beyond his early Refactoring Dojos.
strengths: Strong technical leadership and hands-on coding experience across diverse domains (web, mobile, embedded, AI agents)
Proven ability to architect and maintain developer tooling (MCP code generators, CI/CD, GitLab infrastructure)
Experience leading technical workshops and community initiatives, indicating strong communication and mentorship skills
concerns: Limited direct experience with mobile platforms or developer tools specific to mobile ecosystems (compilers, automated releases, test automation for mobile)
No clear evidence of 3+ years in people management or team leadership beyond early technical leadership roles
Lacks explicit experience in organizational change leadership or strategic roadmap planning for engineering productivity
